mdHint.MD-4: Small spaces, lots of accelerations and duels. The densest session of the week.
mdHint.MD-3: Big spaces, play close to the match, for longer. The game model at full size.
mdHint.MD-2: Short, fast drills with plenty of rest between reps.
mdHint.MD-1: Sharpness, set pieces, freshness. Players leave with energy to spare.
mdHint.MD+1: Active recovery for those who played, light rondos, stretching.
mdHint.youth: No match coming up: play, touch the ball, learn through the game.

dayHint.MD-2: Speed: short, fast, plenty of rest

familyIntro.rondo: Keep the ball in small numbers: the first school of the Njangi.
familyIntro.position: Occupy space with purpose: lanes, lines, the third man.
familyIntro.ssg: Small numbers, lots of touches: read, decide, score.
familyIntro.lsg: The game model on a big pitch, as close to the match as it gets.
familyIntro.phase: One precise phase of the match, repeated against real opposition.
familyIntro.transition: Win it back within five seconds, look forward after winning it.
familyIntro.finishing: Get into the finishing zone and shoot with purpose.
familyIntro.technique: Technique inside the game: oriented touches, one-twos, the third man. Short patterns, repeated just before they are played.

week.peak: The week's peak falls on {{day}} {{label}}. It should sit far from the match: MD-4 or MD-3, never MD-1.
week.logicIntro: With one match a week, load rises early in the week then comes down so players arrive fresh on match day. The day after the match is for recovery; the day after that is rest.
week.logicHeat: In strong heat, train early in the morning or late in the day, add breaks in the shade and plenty of water. With young players, load always stays suited to their age.
